lines.text: Jack says the rabbit wants smoke? Fine, I'll drag a chair in,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: But all I hear is Jack fightin' with the fuckin' air again!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: I'm a Christmas wish made flesh—well, stuffing, to be clear,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You're a clearance-bin hangover that only wakes for beer!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: I was on Johnny Carson's show—the whole crowd went wild,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You did a camcorder dance—never moved an inch, just smiled!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Your answering-machine audition? Dead air, not one rhyme,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Even the WB can't broadcast what exists inside one mind!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You claim you ran a toy-bin gang, took teddy heads clean off,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: That's a badass fuckin' memoir for a guy who can't be caught!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Four years writing Drew; she never sent a single letter back,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You ran a 1-900 thirst poll from a basement full of crap!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Six failed marriages, one to a Monopoly shoe?
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: That's not a fuckin' soulmate, that's a footwear review!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Ross cut off your lucky foot; the kids got all the luck,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: While the bunny stayed downstairs to tell their dad to stay fucked up!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Yeah, I fooled around with produce; eventually I got a wife,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You got Jack's divorce and cheap booze for your entire afterlife!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: I've got Tami-Lynn and Apollo, actual love and shit to do,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Jack, translate this nice and slow: one sober day, and he's through!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: I'm a living, talking bear, you're just a coping mechanism,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: A miserable old prick with a one-man television!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You call yourself a legend? Here's the sting I came to bring:
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You're an imaginary heckler in a real toy's boxing ring!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Well, well! Santa's favorite failure in a beer-stained vest,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: A talking Christmas present with a permanent midlife crisis!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You were on The Tonight Show when talking stuffing got a cheer,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Then the world found better shows and forgot you for thirty years!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You say I'm Jack's crutch? You were jammed up Johnny's ass,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Sabotaging every grown-up step, letting Lori's patience pass!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: She found hookers in her living room and shit upon the floor,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Then you dragged him off to meet Flash Gordon, screaming, "Encore!"
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Donny ripped you at Fenway; suddenly your future went dark,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Took another woman's star wish to bring you back from that park!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Massachusetts took your marriage, job, bank account and pride,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Even Discover told your fluffy little customer goodbye!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Papa Gino's canceled your rewards—that's a special kind of low,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Even a pizza joint refused to trust you with its dough!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: And your soul needed a hearing? Buddy, isn't that sublime?
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Your lawyer had to prove you were a person with a mind!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: I'm the only voice Jack hears? Well, fuck, I won't deny it,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You were Johnny's childhood crutch who couldn't stand his life go quiet!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: And buddy, with no dick, that produce stunt's no flex,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Your sex manual reads, "Discard the parsnip after sex!"
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You mock my shoe-wife? Fine! At least she had a sole,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You needed stars and lawyers to convince 'em you had soul!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Call me a bad idea, a drunken joke, a stain,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: But I never needed all of Boston just to tell me my own name!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Jack, tell your bunny thanks for readin' my case,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: I fought to be a person—he survives through Jack's disgrace!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: A shooting star gave me life; Lori wished me back,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: But I let my best friend grow—you keep yours on a rack!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Tiffany got Harvard; Jack made fifty bucks too much for aid,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: He sold newer cars, quit drinking, and your whole act decayed!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: The second he got sober, you went lifeless on the shelf,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: He bought a beer to wake you. That's him hurting himself!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: That's not friendship! It's a hostage note attached to a can,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You need the guy who loves you to remain a broken man!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Donny tore me up at Fenway; I wished John joy and peace,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Hasbro wanted me in pieces, sold as knockoff copies cheap!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: I won my family back; nobody owns me in a box,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You couldn't stay alive if Jack got off the fuckin' sauce!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Your foot brought lucky breaks; Viagra made your ears stand,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: My kid calls me Dad—you can't even shake a hand!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You call me some pathetic little childhood security blanket?
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: You're the reason Jack's recovery's got a goddamn expiration date, bitch!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: I don't need a dick or blood to know what friendship means,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: And I sure as hell don't need my best friend drunk to keep my seams!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: So crack another beer and call it helping your best friend,
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: I loved mine enough to leave. You won't let yours mend!
lines.speaker: ted

lines.text: Aw, Saint Teddy's back! The Boston Buddha with a bong!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You're right I'm bad for Jack, but you've been wrong for John!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You wrecked his shot with Lori chasing Flash Gordon's party,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Don't act like one apology made you fuckin' Gandhi!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You and Tami-Lynn went nuclear over Filene's petty cash,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: A hundred-twenty-nine bucks nearly made your marriage crash!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You figured having a baby would repair the whole damn mess,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Then took a tour of America's most embarrassing fertility quest!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Sam Jones had lousy swimmers, you went hunting Tom Brady's,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: John got drenched at the clinic—Christ, what a lovely family!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: And Apollo's your boy, fine! I'm not insulting your kid,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: I'm insulting the dumbass reason you wanted one to begin with!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You call me merely imaginary? Fine, don't waste your breath,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: I wrote the stories Jack sold when he had nothing left!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: I pushed him to fight for Tiffany when he wanted to quit,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: I'm the bastard who tells him the truth when nobody else gives a shit!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You needed Lori's star to live; I needed Jack to drink,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Neither one of us chose our strings, so tell me what you think!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: You got a kid who wished for company; I got a man who lost his way,
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Both of us were born from loneliness—mine just tastes like cheap Chardonnay!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Maybe I'm unhealthy! Maybe Jack's a fuckin' wreck!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: But I don't need the world applauding to mean something in his head!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Your courtroom proved your heart was real; well, congratulations, schmuck!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: A court can certify a teddy, but it can't subpoena a thought!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: Now roll the fuckin' cameras! Let the final footage run!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: My voice won't make the playback, but I already had my fun!
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: They'll hear your righteous tantrum, every insult, every cut—
lines.speaker: floppy

lines.text: And see a legally recognized man losing his shit at silent fluff!
lines.speaker: floppy
